meta.title: Rewrite backend and DNS server in Rust with in-memory cache
meta.body_summary: Complete rewrite of backend and DNS server in Rust with in-memory compressed cache, replacing Redis, to improve performance, memory usage, and scalability.

perf_labels.notes: Devin delivered a complete Rust rewrite with 5203 lines, merged within ~3 hours without any formal review or performance evidence; maintainer direct acceptance.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5203 lines across 21 files, this is a large-scale full rewrite, not a typical small performance PR. It was merged directly without any human review, indicating high maintainer trust or auto‑acceptance for agent‑authored changes.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or reviewer feedback; only a bot integration notice from Devin.
review_details.performance_claim: Significant performance improvements due to Rust's efficiency, reduced memory footprint with compressed storage, better scalability.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A full-stack Rust rewrite was delivered and merged without any human review, suggesting that for this repository the maintainer trusts agent-generated code for large-scale changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code review; PR merged directly without any inline comments or approvals.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or numeric performance claim; only narrative benefits.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression checks or review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Complete rewrite of the backend and DNS server in Rust with axum, trust-dns-server, tokio, flate2 compression, and an in‑memory cache replacing Redis; all legacy Python code replaced by new Rust source files under src/.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cargo.lock adds 2390 lines of dependency resolution; tests and configuration files are standard additions.
change_trajectory: Single commit 98223b5: Full Rust rewrite replacing all Python backend components.
